headline: Slifer Deck for Duel Links
title: Slifer the Sky Dragon Deck | Duel Links Cards and Skill | Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links
video_script: Here is how to build a Slifer the Sky Dragon deck in Duel Links. Slifer has no meta deck right now, so this is a fun build with cards you can really get in the game. Remember the Speed Duel rules: only three Monster Zones and four thousand Life Points. Three Tributes means your whole monster field goes into Slifer. The Skill is Card of Sanctity, for Yami Yugi. At the end of a turn where you Normal Summoned Slifer, both players draw until they hold six cards, and six cards means six thousand attack. Ra's Disciple is your Tribute engine. When it is summoned, it brings up to two more from your hand or Deck. While it is on your field, you cannot Special Summon other monsters. Reactor Slime makes two Slime Tokens, so it is three monsters by itself, but for the rest of that turn you can only summon Divine-Beast monsters. Egyptian God Slime counts as three Tributes on its own. Tribute Metal Reflect Slime, a Level ten Aqua with zero attack, to bring it out from your Extra Deck. Monster Reborn brings Slifer back from the Graveyard, but a Special Summoned Slifer goes back to the Graveyard in the End Phase, so attack right away. Which card would you add? Comment below!
